text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground" href="/cn/docs/qa">常见问题解答 (Q&amp;A)</a></li></ul></div></div></div></div><div class="flex-1 min-w-0 scroll-pt-8 overflow-auto" data-docs-scroll-container="true"><main class="flex mx-auto gap-8 w-full max-w-6xl relative "><article data-app-content-body="true" class="flex-1 min-w-0 px-4 sm:px-6 text-muted-foreground lg:px-8 pt-8 pb-8"><div data-copy-exclude="true" class="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground/60">核心功能</span><button type="button" aria-label="复制全文" title="复制全文" class="group/copy inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer select-none shadow-sm backdrop-blur-sm border-border/60 bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60 hover:border-border hover:shadow-md"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center transition-transform duration-200 group-hover/copy:scale-105"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-clipboard-copy size-4" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="8" height="4" x="8" y="2" rx="1" ry="1"></rect><path d="M8 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="automations">自动化<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有些工作不需要你每次亲自发起：每天早上汇总代码变更、每周五整理发布简报、每月检查一次依赖风险。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动化</strong> 让 ZCode Agent 按你设定的节奏自己跑起来，跑完把结果留在会话里等你查看。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自动化下面有两类任务：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">定时任务（Scheduled tasks）</strong>：你指定时间和重复规则，到点自动执行。本页介绍。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">闲时任务</strong>：不指定时间，排队等算力富余时免费执行。见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/idle-time-tasks">闲时任务</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在左侧边栏点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动化</strong> 即可打开管理页面。它属于当前项目的工作流，不在设置里——打开它不会影响左侧的会话列表，随时可以退回原来的会话。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/automations/automation-overview-annotated.webp" alt="自动化主视图：定时任务与闲时任务两个标签页、保持唤醒开关，以及已创建任务的调度摘要、下次运行时间和运行次数" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="create">创建定时任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有三种方式，效果一致，选顺手的即可。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="create-form">用表单创建<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在自动化页面点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建定时任务</strong>，填写四样东西：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">任务标题</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">用于在列表和历史里识别这个任务</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">执行计划</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">什么时候跑、多久跑一次，见下文 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#schedule">调度规则</a></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">指令</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">每次触发时发给 Agent 的内容，写清楚要做什么、产出什么</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目 / 权限 / 模型 / 推理强度</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">指令输入框下方的工具条，见下文 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#config">任务配置</a></td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="create-in-chat">在会话里创建<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击创建按钮右侧的箭头，选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">去会话中创建</strong>，输入框会预填一句示例，你可以直接改成自己的需求，例如：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-text">每个工作日 9 点，汇总当前项目的代码变更和待跟进事项。
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">用这种方式创建的任务会 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">绑定到当前会话</strong>：后续每次触发都把结果投递回同一个会话，而不是每次新开一个。适合希望所有产出集中在一处的场景。创建成功后，会话里会出现一张任务卡片，点击「去到定时任务」可以直接跳到它的详情。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="create-template">从模板创建<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自动化首页提供四个现成模板，点击即可预填完整指令，改改就能用：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作日晨会动态</strong> — 汇总昨日进展与今日重点</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">每日风险扫描</strong> — 检查代码库中的潜在问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">周五发布简报</strong> — 整理本周变更，形成发布说明</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">周三文档同步检查</strong> — 核对文档与代码是否脱节</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这些模板都遵循同一套约束：只做只读分析、只使用可验证的仓库事实、证据不足时明确说明，不推测，也不修改代码。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="schedule">调度规则<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在执行计划里选择频率：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">每小时 / 每天 / 每工作日 / 每周 / 每月 / 自定义</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">选择「自定义」会打开重复规则对话框，可以组合出更细的节奏：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">维度</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">可选值</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重复单位</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">小时、天、周、月、年</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">间隔</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">每 N 个单位执行一次，例如「每 2 小时」「每 3 天」</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">具体时点</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">周几、每月几号、几月份，以及具体的时和分</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">按日期或按星期</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">每月重复时，可选「每月 15 号」或「每月第三个周一」</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/automations/custom-schedule-dialog.webp" alt="自定义重复对话框：按周重复并勾选周几，结束条件可选永不结束或指定日期" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">确认后，调度栏会收起成一句简短摘要，点击摘要可以再次编辑。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="schedule-end">什么时候停下来<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">定时任务默认无限重复。希望它到某个日期后自动停止，可以在自定义重复对话框的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">结束</strong> 一栏选「指定日期」；到期后任务进入「已完成」状态，不再触发。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">界面上没有「最多跑几次」这个选项。确实需要限定次数时，可以在会话里让 Agent 帮你建这个定时任务，直接说明跑几次就行。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">关于时间</strong>：所有时间都按你电脑的本地时区计算。任务卡片上会显示下次运行时间——一个月以内显示相对时间（如「3 天后」），超过一个月显示具体日期。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="config">任务配置<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">指令输入框下方的工具条决定这个任务以什么身份、什么能力执行：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目</strong>：任务在哪个项目目录下运行。只能选当前窗口已打开的本地项目，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建后不可修改</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">权限</strong>：和会话里一样的<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/agents#modes">四档执行模式</a>，决定 Agent 能不能自己动手改文件、跑命令。选了「完全访问」时界面会一直留一个橙色提醒。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型</strong>：指定执行时使用的模型，留空则跟随项目默认。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">推理强度</strong>：控制思考深度，留空则跟随项目默认。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">因为定时任务在你不盯着的时候执行，权限选择尤其值得斟酌——需要 Agent 自主改代码就放开权限，只想要一份分析报告就保持只读。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="manage">管理与运行<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="run-now">立即运行<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务卡片菜单里的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">立即运行</strong> 会马上执行一次。它不打乱原本的计划——下次运行时间、已运行次数、启停状态都不会因此改变。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/automations/scheduled-task-create-form-annotated.png" alt="定时任务详情页：状态、调度摘要、指令和底部工具条，右上角可保存修改或立即运行" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果上一次触发还没跑完，重复点击不会排第二条，界面会提示「上一条正在运行」。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="lifecycle">暂停、编辑与删除<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务有四种状态：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">运行中、已暂停、已完成、失败</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">暂停后任务保留但不再触发，卡片上的执行时间与运行次数会弱化显示，随时可以恢复。编辑时如果有未保存的改动，返回前会提示你确认是否丢弃。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="history">运行历史<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务详情页顶部可以在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 / 历史</strong> 之间切换。历史里记录每一次触发的结果，包括执行中、成功、失败，以及因为电脑未唤醒而 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">跳过</strong> 的那些。有对应会话的记录可以直接跳转过去查看当时发生了什么。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-automations/schedule-run-history-annotated.webp" alt="定时任务运行历史：设置 / 历史 切换，列表里依次是成功、失败与因电脑未唤醒而跳过的记录，行末菜单可跳到对应会话" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="limits">需要注意的限制<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑必须是唤醒状态。</strong> 定时任务在你的电脑上执行，机器睡眠或应用未启动时不会触发，错过的一次性任务会记为跳过而不是补跑。如果任务安排在夜间或午休时段，请在自动化页面打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">保持唤醒</strong> 开关——这是一个全局开关，定时任务和闲时任务共用。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">最多 20 条。</strong> 这是跨所有项目的总数，暂停、已完成、失败的任务同样占用名额，只有删除任务定义才会释放。达到上限时新建会被拦下，需要先去清理不再需要的任务。在会话里让 Agent 创建时如果撞上上限，它会直接告诉你并停下，不会自作主张删掉你已有的任务。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只支持本地项目。</strong> 新建任务时只能选当前窗口打开的本地项目，远程工作区不在支持范围内（已有的远程任务仍可查看和管理）。手机端远程控制界面不显示自动化。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
